content: {"summary":"The January 2026 kafka-03 data‑volume alarm was driven by two large topics, `ledger.entries` and `notifications.outbound`.  `notifications.outbound` was trimmed by applying a one‑day retention, while `ledger.entries` retained its 14‑day audit retention and cannot be trimmed without finance sign‑off.","likely_cause":"Long retention on `ledger.entries` (14 days) combined with default retention on `notifications.outbound` caused the data‑volume increase; trimming `notifications.outbound` reduced usage.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The large topics contributing to the volume are `ledger.entries` and `notifications.outbound`.","evidence_ids":["INC-0120#0"],"quote":"Two topics stand well clear of the rest: `ledger.entries` and `notifications.outbound`."},{"text":"`notifications.outbound` can be trimmed by setting a shorter retention (one day).","evidence_ids":["INC-0120#1"],"quote":"set `retention.ms=86400000` on `notifications.outbound`: one day, no restart needed."},{"text":"`ledger.entries` retains 14 days for audit and cannot be trimmed without finance sign‑off.","evidence_ids":["INC-0120#0"],"quote":"`ledger.entries` keeps 14 days for audit, twice the broker default"}],"next_checks":["Verify current retention settings for both topics after the change","Monitor kafka-03 disk usage for several days to confirm the trim effect","Check consumer lag for `notifications.outbound` before further retention reductions","Confirm finance approval process for any future changes to `ledger.entries` retention"]}
